storage: IndexedDB database yeobaek-pds, object store documents, key current
visibility: The application is public. Records are local to the browser and origin; no device sync or sharing.
transaction: A read-modify-write IndexedDB transaction updates a single linked document atomically, serializing simultaneous tabs.

collections.plans: id, title, start_date, end_date, priority, success_criteria, estimated_minutes, source_review_id, improvement, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
collections.versions: id, plan_id, version, immutable snapshot of plan, created_at
collections.tasks: id, plan_id, title, due_date, priority, tags, estimated_minutes, completed, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
collections.executions: id, task_id, started_at, ended_at, actual_minutes, blocked_reason, unique idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
collections.reviews: id, plan_id, from_date, to_date, reflection, improvement, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

rules.id: Monotonically increasing safe integer across all collections except completions; restored IDs are preserved.
rules.history: Version 1 stores original plan; every edit appends a full snapshot with the same plan ID.
rules.completion: Set desired state rather than toggle; repeated completion leaves one completion record per task.
rules.execution: Retrying a save with the same idempotency_key returns its existing ID. Original plan estimates do not change.
rules.timezone: Asia/Seoul; dates YYYY-MM-DD; execution input and display in Seoul; persisted timestamps ISO 8601 UTC.
rules.duration: Integer minute; actual_minutes = (ended_at - started_at) / 60000; expected/actual/difference empty sums are zero.
rules.cohort: Selected plan, non-deleted tasks, optional inclusive due_date bounds. Actual sum includes all non-deleted executions of cohort tasks.
rules.delayed: Count incomplete cohort tasks with due_date before today in Seoul; completed tasks are excluded.
rules.blocked: Count distinct cohort tasks with at least one non-deleted execution with a non-blank blocking reason.
rules.difference: Sum actual execution minutes minus sum task estimated minutes.
rules.evidence: Every metric links to its task cohort/subset; opening a task displays its linked execution records.
rules.next_plan: At most one next plan per review; copy improvement and keep source_review_id.
rules.delete: Soft delete, preserving audit records in export and excluding them from views and sums.
rules.backup: JSON export includes all six collections. Restore validates values, IDs, references, history and uniqueness before atomic replacement. Paper diary notes are not overwritten.

assignment_gap: Browser persistence is not server DB persistence (T06-C34). Real records must be entered by the user, not generated as evidence.
